latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release of CSAM Shield — a critical safety system for detecting and preventing CSAM.

- Provides advanced computer vision, hash matching, age estimation, anatomical and behavioral analysis to identify child sexual abuse material.
- Automates NCMEC CyberTipline reporting, evidence preservation, law enforcement notifications, and user account actions.
- Offers configurable thresholds, extensive API methods, and strict security controls (encryption, audit logging, access restriction).
- Delivers real-time content blocking, automatic user suspension, and detection of grooming or distribution networks.
- Strong emphasis on legal compliance, privacy, staff mental health, and evidence management.
